collectionMethod: Two inputs this round. (a) Maintainer-provided screenshot of the Kimi App usage-analysis page on an account whose plan tier is unconfirmed: all usage on model k3.1-pro inside a 7-day Code window. (b) Official Kimi pages announcing the new subscription plans Go / Plus / Pro / Max / Ultra (CN ¥49/¥99/¥199/¥699/¥1399; international $19/$39/$99/$199), fetched 2026-10-26, plus the maintainer ruling of the same day that each new-plan monthly allowance equals half of the same-price legacy plan's allowance. Research file only for the screenshot measurement; the ruling is adopted through new v2 rows derived in build_adopted.py.
sources: Maintainer screenshot of the Kimi App usage analysis, attached in session 2026-10-26 (private original)
https://www.kimi.com/pricing and the new-plan help pages (new plan names, prices, Kimi Code inclusion by tier, Agent-credit multipliers), read 2026-10-26
Maintainer ruling 2026-10-26: "kimi的v2订阅额度是v1的一半"
scope: New Kimi plan lineup (v2 plans in repository vocabulary) plus one weekly-pool measurement on k3.1-pro from an account of unknown tier (maintainer guesses a legacy plan). The new plans drop the 7-day cap and keep only a rolling 5-hour limit plus the monthly shared pool, so a weekly figure cannot be attributed to a v2 account anyway.
adoptionStatus: v2 rows adopted: kimi_plus_cn / kimi_pro_cn / kimi_max_cn / kimi_ultra_cn × {kimi-k3, kimi-k2.7-code} = same-price v1 value x 1/2 (Ultra x2 of Max per official Agent-credit ratio). The screenshot measurement itself is research-only: plan tier unconfirmed, so it adopts nothing and changes no adopted row.

officialPlanPage.windowModel: New plans remove the 7-day limit; Plus and above keep a rolling 5-hour limit plus the shared monthly pool. Go has no Kimi Code.
officialPlanPage.k3Access: K3 base: legacy Moderato+ / new Plus+. K3 1M context and HighSpeed: legacy Allegretto+ / new Pro+.

maintainerRuling.ruling: 新套餐（v2）同价位额度 = 旧套餐（v1）的 1/2。Ultra 无 v1 同价档，按官方 Agent 额度 28/14 = 2x Max 派生；Go 无 Kimi Code 不入点。

screenshotMeasurement.planAttribution: Unconfirmed. Maintainer guesses a legacy (v1) plan; the window shown is a 7-day tile, which is consistent with a legacy account since v2 plans dropped weekly caps.

weeklyPoolBackCalc.note: Raw client totals, same basis as the repository's existing Kimi rows; not workload-normalized.

comparison.vsAdoptedLegacy: 1.095B weekly would be ~5.48B monthly at the 5x pool ratio, inside the v1 spread (Andante 0.78 / Moderato 2.90 / Allegretto 14.51 / Allegro 43.53 yi) — it does not isolate a tier.
comparison.vsNewPlans: If the account were a v2 plan it would most plausibly sit near Pro 199 (7.25B monthly = 1.45B weekly-equivalent), but the weekly tile itself argues against v2. Unresolved.

whatWouldUpgradeThisSample: The plan name shown on the account's subscription page, to attribute the 10.95B weekly figure to a tier.
Whether k3.1-pro consumes credits at the k3-256k or the K3 1M rate on this account.
confidence: low-to-medium for the screenshot (unattributed tier, single window); ruling itself is authoritative
redaction: The screenshot shows usage bars, percentages and reset dates only; no name, avatar, e-mail or account ID.
